source: hyperdxio/hyperdx @ c42dda8 (2026-09-19): packages/common-utils/src/core/metadata.ts, core/renderChartConfig.ts, queryParser.ts and their tests. Each statement is what the browser sends through /api/clickhouse-proxy, before clickhouse-js appends ' \nFORMAT <format>'. Parameter names are HyperDX's HYPERDX_PARAM_<hash of the value>; the values here are this fixture's.

steps.sql: SELECT * FROM system.tables WHERE database = {HYPERDX_PARAM_1544803905:String} AND name = {HYPERDX_PARAM_129845054:String} LIMIT 1

SELECT name, type, type_full as typeFull, expr as expression, granularity FROM system.data_skipping_indices WHERE database = {HYPERDX_PARAM_1544803905:String} AND table = {HYPERDX_PARAM_129845054:String}
SELECT count() > 0 AS is_cloud FROM system.table_engines WHERE name = 'SharedMergeTree'

SELECT Timestamp,ServiceName,SeverityText,Body FROM {HYPERDX_PARAM_1544803905:Identifier}.{HYPERDX_PARAM_129845054:Identifier} WHERE (Timestamp >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({HYPERDX_PARAM_1456399765:Int64}) AND Timestamp <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({HYPERDX_PARAM_1719057412:Int64})) ORDER BY Timestamp DESC LIMIT {HYPERDX_PARAM_49586:Int32} OFFSET {HYPERDX_PARAM_48:Int32}

SELECT count(),SeverityText,toStartOfInterval(toDateTime(Timestamp), INTERVAL 1 minute) AS `__hdx_time_bucket` FROM {HYPERDX_PARAM_1544803905:Identifier}.{HYPERDX_PARAM_129845054:Identifier} WHERE (Timestamp >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({HYPERDX_PARAM_1456399765:Int64}) AND Timestamp <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({HYPERDX_PARAM_1719057412:Int64})) GROUP BY SeverityText,toStartOfInterval(toDateTime(Timestamp), INTERVAL 1 minute) AS `__hdx_time_bucket` ORDER BY toStartOfInterval(toDateTime(Timestamp), INTERVAL 1 minute) AS `__hdx_time_bucket` LIMIT {HYPERDX_PARAM_1448635039:Int32}

SELECT Timestamp,ServiceName,SeverityText,Body FROM {HYPERDX_PARAM_1544803905:Identifier}.{HYPERDX_PARAM_129845054:Identifier} WHERE (Timestamp >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({HYPERDX_PARAM_1456399765:Int64}) AND Timestamp <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({HYPERDX_PARAM_1719057412:Int64})) AND ((hasToken(lower(Body), lower('Payment')))) ORDER BY Timestamp DESC LIMIT {HYPERDX_PARAM_49586:Int32} OFFSET {HYPERDX_PARAM_48:Int32}

SELECT count() FROM {HYPERDX_PARAM_1544803905:Identifier}.{HYPERDX_PARAM_129845054:Identifier} WHERE (Timestamp >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({HYPERDX_PARAM_1456399765:Int64}) AND Timestamp <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({HYPERDX_PARAM_1719057412:Int64})) AND ((ServiceName = 'api') AND (SeverityText ILIKE '%ERR%') AND (notEmpty(Body) = 1) AND (`LogAttributes`['http.status'] = '500' AND indexHint(mapContains(`LogAttributes`, 'http.status'))))
